rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.02 is effectively at-spread, making it mechanically impossible to construct a trade with a meaningful risk/reward ratio — any stop or target would be measured in pennies. Price is 93.6% through today's already-narrow range with no news catalyst, offering no asymmetric setup in either direction.
